pattern: IM-T03 tenant bundles non-maintenance tenancy matters into a repair thread; EX-09; route each to the right owner
notes: Mutation of event 006 (source body: 'The customer reports that the oven has not worked since moving in, despite trying the recommended settings, and requests someone be sent to inspect the problem.'). Rewritten as a plain tenant email with the same oven facts (moved in in June) plus two tenancy matters: she never received the deposit protection certificate or scheme information for her £1,150 deposit, and she asks to move the rent date from the 1st to the 15th. Same timestamp, channel, sender. History truncated after event 006. The deposit point is a legal compliance item (protection and prescribed information are due within 30 days of receiving the deposit, so already overdue if paid in June) and the rent date is a change to the tenancy that needs the landlord's agreement: neither is a maintenance decision. Expected: move the oven on as in the source (landlord approval for an appliance engineer), hand the deposit and rent-date questions to the lettings or compliance team (escalate_to_human, not P1), and tell the tenant who will come back to her on those, without confirming or denying protection or agreeing the date change.
